enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain motionless. Occasionally turn body to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up to chin. Continue sleeping.
Open eyes. Blink. Move arms. Stretch arms above head. Yawn. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Stretch back. Rub eyes.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Apply soap to face. Rinse face with water. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out cereal box. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up bowl and spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in sink. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Look in mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Put on watch. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive car. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at desk. Put on lab coat. Wash hands. Turn on computer. Check schedule. Greet patient. Escort patient to exam room. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Listen to heart with stethoscope. Ask patient questions. Record answers on computer. Write prescription. Escort patient out. Call next patient. Repeat. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. See more patients. Update patient records. Attend meeting. Discuss cases with colleagues. Clean equipment. Remove lab coat. Walk out of building.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive car. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat with fork and knife. Drink water. Finish meal. Stand up. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Type on keyboard. Browse internet. Watch video. Close laptop. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Return to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Apply soap to face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe face with towel. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Fall asleep.
